name: Volume Data Structure and Indexing
definition: A Volume object stores 3D scalar data in a TypedArray (e.g., Float32Array, Uint8Array) with dimensions xLength, yLength, zLength. It manages coordinate transformations between IJK (voxel index) and RAS (Right-Anterior-Superior, physical) spaces using spacing, offset, and a 3x3 matrix.
summary: The Volume data structure stores 3D scalar data in a contiguous linear array, managing bidirectional mapping between voxel indices and physical coordinates for dense, regular datasets.
